name: smwsprites-spiny-egg-shooter
title: Spiny Egg Shooter
description:
Hotfix update: Added a "!InitStatus" define for more control over what spawns.

This Shooter sprite shoots a Spiny Egg straight upwards at a constant interval.

Customizable aspects (using the defines):
- Two different intervals to shoot Spiny Eggs at
- What (vanilla) sprite to shoot (if you'd want to shoot something other than Spiny Eggs)
- What (vanilla) sprite to shoot when the Silver P switch is active.
- The Status of the spawned object (if, for example, wanting to spawn a Koopa Shell)
